title: White Line: A Typed Ledger for the Edge of the Claim
description:
A typed ledger for absence: epistemic gaps, ethical restraint, and contemplative negative space. It records what is missing, withheld, or unresolved under a total caution order, decays stale namings past their review horizons, and refuses to infer why anything is absent. Withholding is recorded as a boundary, never mined as missing evidence.

Subtitle: Keeping missing evidence, ethical boundaries, and open questions from becoming unsupported claims

notes: White Line is a peer instrument whose current membership belongs to https://github.com/docxology/line_set; the original four were Red, Black, Golden, and White. The colorless reader and Witness Register are not colors. Copper resource accounting does not quantify White gaps or prove fair allocation; missing recovery evidence can be White absence, while Iron recorded recovery target comparisons do not promise future recovery. Violet, Copper, and Iron sources are access-controlled. Five existing sibling DOI relationships are retained historical identities, not an exhaustive inventory. Membership is not source access.
